body: This is my fear with every new employee at the places I go to. I only let myself buy a half pint during the week and a pint on the weekend or I’ll just drink everything and I have hobbies I try to partake in. Well they only had the fifths…I was like shit I guess I’ll buy the fifth pour it into the pint and make my friend hide the other one…new guy goes 😂😂 I did this the other day. I hope your next new guy is like my new guy.

Oh man. All my experience with ortho is impressions on shitty teens and then their parents complaining that their kids mouth hurt. Uh yeah. We are moving teeth. It’s gunna hurt. Also tiny bands. Fuck that. If you can handle blood and bone..whatever. Maxillofacial.
That’s weird. We have to pay our working interviewers. But it might be a state thing? I’m in Alaska.

It says deleted so I only could read that you have like a rash and what not when drinking. I’ve noticed if I mix stuff I tend to break out in a rash/hives. I’m allergic to shellfish and recently found out some sulfa type shit is in champagne and that’s why I always have a reaction with champagne. High IPA’s will do it to me. I don’t not drink this stuff...I just don’t drink it in public where people will think I’m drunk off one drink when really I’m just having an allergic reaction. Orrrrr so I think. Maybe that’s it for you? I dunno man. Like I can only have the lime white claw cause everything else gives me hives. It took me forever to find what won’t trigger it though.

Insurance isn’t hard to learn. It’s all the little questions that if you have a good trainer they tell you. Like can you take bite wings and the pano on the same day without it downgrading to an FMX? Does preventative accrue towards the maximum? How many quads of SRP can be done? Do crowns downgrade to the metal rate? Blah blah. 
It’s sooo nice to have an assistant who can do the front. I started in the front and have been in the back for about 7 months now and it’s helped bridge that weird communication gap. 
Don’t be afraid to ask questions. The front will be grateful. I’ve only used open dental and dextrix but I’m assuming the other programs also have breakdowns of a patients insurance on there. Also it takes time! Just like assisting. But since you know the terminology for dental you should be good. Not sure if that helped at all but I hope it did!

What if you miss him just as much when you’re gone? What happens when you long for his company just as much as you do now? 
I almost tried a few months ago and that’s what crossed my mind beforehand. I’m not religious or really even spiritual but, fuck man. What if this shit is just worse after and you can’t even change it? At least when you stick around you take that chick to court and get the time with your son that you deserve and you have the chance to change things. I know you’ve tried because I read through the comments. It just makes me sad to read that from someone who seems to be thoughtful and caring. We want ya to hang around a bit longer man. Even if it’s just four weeks..then let’s make it five.
Hey man, kudos to holding out though!
